description: The client's decision on one publication's latest outline or draft from get_client_order. Approving an outline starts the draft; approving the draft sends it to our editors for a final read, and cannot be undone. Show the client the full text and get their explicit go-ahead first. Changes can be asked for twice per piece; after that our team works with the client directly.

feedback.description: With action "changes": what to change, in the client's words.

orderLink.description: The client's private order link (https://theprofound.agency/order/<id>/#t=…), or just the token after #t=. It is the "Open your order page" button in the order confirmation email sent when the order is paid.

publication.description: Which publication on the order: its name or publicationId from get_client_order. Needed when the order has more than one; each publication has its own content, outline and draft.

name: review_content
title: Approve, or ask for changes to, an outline or draft
